			add = {

				desc = "from_capitalists_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists and landowners more likely to join with progressive taxation
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_capitalists_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists more likely to join conservatives with public health
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_health_insurance
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_capitalists_health"
			}
		}
		if = { # devout, industrialists more likely to join conservatives with public schools
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pious
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_capitalists_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # devout more likely to join conservatives with total separation
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moralist
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_devout_separation"
			}
		}
		if = { # devout more likely to join conservatives with freedom of conscience
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moralist
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_freedom_of_conscience
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_devout_conscience"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriarchs more likely to join conservatives with women's suffrage
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriarchal
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_patriarchy"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriarchs more likely to join conservatives with working women
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriarchal
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_patriarchy_lesser"
			}
		}
		if = { # reactionaries like regressing from multiculturalism
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reactionary
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_multiculturalism"
			}
		}
		# alliance for stricter internal security
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_absolutist
					leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian }
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_home_affairs
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_liberty"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like censorship
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriarchal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_absolutist
					leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_censorship"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives hate republics
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moralist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_magnatial
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist_ig
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderantist
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_republic"
			}
		}
		if = { # landowners and industrialists hate labor rights
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
				}
				OR = {
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_labor_rights"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives hate welfare
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
				}
				OR = {
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wage_subsidies
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_welfare"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like police
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_paternalist_ideology = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_absolutist
				}
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		# Austria
		if = { # Austrian Devout want to be part of the CSU
			limit = {
				c:AUS ?= owner
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				NOR = {
					interest_group_has_liberal_ideology = yes
					interest_group_has_progressive_ideology = yes
					interest_group_has_socialist_ideology = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_austrian_devout"
			}
		}
		if = { # Corporatism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
				c:AUS ?= owner
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_corporatism"
			}
		}

		# His Highness Marshal Baldomero Espartero, Viceroy of Navarre, Prince of Vergara, Duke of la Victoria, Duke of Morella, Count of Luchana, and Viscount of Banderas will never, ever join the Moderate Party.
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_template = SPA_baldomero_espartero
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -1000
				desc = "from_baldomero_espartero"
			}
		}
		else_if = { # Narváez totally will, though
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_template = SPA_ramon_maria_narvaez
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 100
				desc = "from_conservative_leader"
			}
		}

		# Special weights for ACW
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
						AND = { # JE not active yet at initialization
							exists = c:USA
							exists = c:USA
							c:USA ?= THIS
							year < 1837
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver } }
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "from_slaver_leader"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist } }
				add = {
					value = -100
					desc = "from_abolitionist_leader"
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = political_agitation } }
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_miguelist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		########## TGR ADJUSTMENTS ##########
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0					#0.5	#We want max 2 IG in each party
				desc = "Will not join a party that has more than 2 IGs"
			}
		}
		#else_if = {
		#	limit = {
		#		scope:number = 3
		#	}
		#	multiply = {
		#		value = 0.05
		#		desc = "from_three_prior_members"
		#	}
		#}
		#####################################
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
				desc = "from_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number > 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_more_than_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-orleanist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						is_powerful = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = conservative_party
						}
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-legitimist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						is_powerful = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = conservative_party
						}
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-bonapartist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						is_powerful = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = conservative_party
						}
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				leader ?= {
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= this
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_monarchist_leanings"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1000
				desc = "from_jacksonian_democrat"
			}
		}
		if = { # Brazil
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_coffee_with_milk
						has_journal_entry = je_populist_unrest
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_milk_coffee"

		if = {

				owner = {

					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone

					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout

				value = 10

					has_variable = caudillo_conservative

			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "caudillo_support"

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:yankee
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_northern_interests"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:dixie
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_southern_interests"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1000
				desc = "from_jacksonian_democrat"
			}
		}
		if = { # Also Brazil
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_populist_unrest
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -1000
				desc = "from_populist_discontent"
			}
		}
	}
}

				desc = party_venstre
				trigger = {

				}

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_liberal

				}
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_early_trade_unions"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							}
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
			}
		}
		# Special weights for ACW
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
						AND = { # JE not active yet at initialization
							exists = c:USA
							exists = c:USA
							c:USA ?= THIS
							year < 1837
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver } }
				add = {
					value = -100
					desc = "from_slaver_leader"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist } }
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "from_abolitionist_leader"
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-orleanist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = liberal_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-legitimist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = liberal_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-bonapartist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = liberal_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= this
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_july_monarchy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
	         		country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					heir ?= {
						has_template = BRZ_emperor_pedro_02
						has_trait = trait_child
					}
	         	}
				leader ?= {
					has_template = BRZ_diogo_antonio_feijo
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_feijo_regency"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
	         		country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					heir ?= {
						has_template = BRZ_emperor_pedro_02
						has_trait = trait_child
					}
	         	}
				leader ?= {
					has_template = BRZ_diogo_antonio_feijo
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_feijo_regency"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				}
				leader ?= {
					NOR = {
						has_reactionary_ideology = yes
						has_conservative_ideology = yes
						has_socialist_ideology = yes
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "usa_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:yankee
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					leader ?= {
						has_template = usa_robert_rantoul_character_template # Northern Democrat
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -10
					desc = "from_northern_democrats"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "from_northern_interests"
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = political_agitation } }
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_miguelist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:dixie
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_southern_interests"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_variable = caudillo_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "caudillo_support"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number <= 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		########## TGR ADJUSTMENTS ##########
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0					#0.5	#We want max 2 IG in each party
				desc = "Will not join a party that has more than 2 IGs"
			}
		}
		#else_if = {
		#	limit = {
		#		scope:number = 3
		#	}
		#	multiply = {
		#		value = 0.05
		#		desc = "from_three_prior_members"
		#	}
		#}
		#####################################
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
				desc = "from_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number > 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_more_than_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
	}
}

						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_weak_radicals"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak liberals will fall in line behind strong radicals
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_weak_liberals_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak leftists will fall in line behind radicals pre-revolution
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_weak_leftists_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards radicalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_progressives_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # particularists will join in when their issues are relevant
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_debt_slavery
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_particularism_cares_about_laws"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # from lack of democracy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # radical anti-censorship
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian_modern
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to secret police or national guard
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = from_bad_home_affairs
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_slavery
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian_modern
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_slavery
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # early Trade Unions
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 1 # If someone else is in this party first
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = { has_technology_researched = labor_movement }
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_socialist
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_early_trade_unions"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							}
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		########## TGR ADJUSTMENTS ##########
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0					#0.5	#We want max 2 IG in each party
				desc = "Will not join a party that has more than 2 IGs"
			}
		}
		#else_if = {
		#	limit = {
		#		scope:number = 3
		#	}
		#	multiply = {
		#		value = 0.05
		#		desc = "from_three_prior_members"
		#	}
		#}
		#####################################
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
				desc = "from_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number > 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_more_than_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:religious_party = {
	color = { 100 100 100 }
	name = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_fatherland_front
				trigger = {
					exists = c:AUS
					exists = c:AUS
					c:AUS ?= THIS
					any_interest_group = {
						is_in_government = yes
						party ?= {
							is_party_type = religious_party
						}
					}
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
					has_variable = fatherland_front_var
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_catholic_peoples_party
				trigger = {
					exists = c:AUS
					exists = c:AUS
					c:AUS ?= THIS
					NAND = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							party ?= {
								is_party_type = fascist_party
							}
						}
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
						has_variable = fatherland_front_var
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_nationalist_party
				trigger = {
					c:POR ?= this
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = corporatism
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_portuguese_catholic_centre
				trigger = {
					c:POR ?= this
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_catholic_right
				trigger = {
					exists = c:SWI
					exists = c:SWI
					c:SWI ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anti_revolutionary_party
				trigger = {
					exists = c:NET
					exists = c:NET
					c:NET ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_learned_council
				trigger = {
					exists = c:PER
					exists = c:PER
					c:PER ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_traditionalist_communion
				trigger = {
					exists = c:SPA
					exists = c:SPA
					c:SPA ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_christian_peoples_party
				trigger = {
					exists = c:BEL
					exists = c:BEL
					c:BEL ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_clerical_party
				trigger = {
					exists = c:FRA
					THIS = c:FRA
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_union_of_the_russian_people
				trigger = {
					exists = c:RUS
					exists = c:RUS
					c:RUS ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_know_nothing_party
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_zentrum
				trigger = {
					AND = {
						OR = {
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
						}
						OR = {
							country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {#中央党
				desc = party_dzp
				trigger = {
					AND = {
						OR = {
							c:GER ?= THIS
							c:HRE ?= THIS
							c:PRU ?= THIS
							c:NGF ?= THIS
						}
						OR = {
							country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_conservative_catholics
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
					}
					NOR = {
						c:AUS ?= this
						c:KUK ?= this
						c:HRE ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_moderate_venstre
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_shinto
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:shinto
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_buddhist
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_dharmic
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_sikh
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:sikh
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_hindu
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:hindu
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_jewish
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:jewish
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_muslim
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_islamic
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_catholic
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_christian
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_christian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_hindu_mahasabha
				trigger = {
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hindu_moralist
					}
					OR = {
						c:BIC ?= this
						c:BHT ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_religious
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/religious.dds"
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		owner = {
			country_has_voting_franchise = yes
		}
	}

	# Root - IG considering joining
	# scope:number - the number of IGs that would join this party before the root IG
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		########## TGR ADJUSTMENTS ##########
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "Devouts are a natural member of this party"
			}
		}
		#####################################
		if = { #德国教会中央党
            limit = {
                owner ?= {
                	OR = {
                		country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
                		country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
                	}
                }
                OR = {
                	 is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
                	 is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
                }
            }
            add = {
                value = 50
                desc = "from_centre_party"
            }
        }
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "usa_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = corporatism
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_relevant_landowners"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_theocracy"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the devout don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:religious_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:religious_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_devout ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:religious_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_no_devout_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # a party for powerful religious people
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_devout"
			}
		}
		if = { # religiously inclined people might join if devout are powerful
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_devout_other"
			}
		}
		if = { # antireligious characters and IG's will never join
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_clerical
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = "from_antireligious"
			}
		}
		if = { # Corporatism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					c:AUS ?= owner
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_corporatism"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriarchs more likely to join conservatives with women's suffrage
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriarchal
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_patriarchy"
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = political_agitation } }
				leader = {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_miguelist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_powerful = yes
				NOT = {
					c:AUS ?= owner
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		########## TGR ADJUSTMENTS ##########
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0					#0.5	#We want max 2 IG in each party
				desc = "Will not join a party that has more than 2 IGs"
			}
		}
		#else_if = {
		#	limit = {
		#		scope:number = 3
		#	}
		#	multiply = {
		#		value = 0.05
		#		desc = "from_three_prior_members"
		#	}
		#}
		#####################################
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
				desc = "from_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number > 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_more_than_three_prior_members"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-orleanist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = religious_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-legitimist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = religious_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-bonapartist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = religious_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
	}
}
